dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It might be cool, but it still comes from the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: You're right! No wonder the captain was yelling at us to hurry up — as soon as we're ready, we can get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Przybor
dialogues.text: It can't be easy being a Fatuus these days. It's not enough to know how to fight, you've gotta learn to operate all this advanced stuff too... *sigh* Do you think they give training to newcomers?
